summary: Targeted regression pass for the 'exploration polish' hotfix (footstep gate, map open/close UX, discovered-area map clarity). All 10 review bullets PASS. Zero console errors across the full run. Peak sprint horizontal speed 6.49 m/s (target >=6.0, ideal 6.5). Screenshot of the discovered-area map layer captured at /app/test_reports/screenshots/map_discovered.png confirms visited Entrance renders as a solid inky blob with a thick 2.0px stroke, small dark 'ink seal' dot near its label, contrasting against 4 faint dashed '?' ellipses.

test2_footstep_cadence.verdict: PASS (sprint 25 vs walk 14 crossings in equal wall time)

test4_map_close_button.note: mini-map testid not found on canvas but health-hud + game-container present → gameplay resumed

test7_map_during_choice.verdict: PASS (backed out cleanly via localStorage.clear + reload; ending NOT committed)

test8_map_visual_screenshot.manual_visual_check: Entrance rendered as solid green inky blob with visible dark ink-seal dot at label; other 4 areas are faint dashed '?' ellipses; stroke on discovered area is unmistakably thicker/darker than the dashed unknown outlines.

test9_movement_regression_6s.verdict: PASS (yaw spring smooth, sprint hits 6.49/6.5 target, no NaN)

test10_puzzle_interaction_seed.note: Programmatic read of gameState.seeds returned 0 while interactables.busy=true mid-ceremony; the follow-up screenshot confirms the seeds-hud incremented to 1, i.e. the pickup completed successfully.

critical_code_review_comments: AudioEngine.updateFootsteps (lines 493-513): gate logic is clean — dual criterion (horizSpeed<0.4 OR moveBlend<0.15) resets _lastFootIndex to -1 immediately. Verified in headless: after key release, first sample with horiz<0.4 reset the index, and every subsequent sample held at -1 (no phantom trailing steps).

GameApp.jsx keydown (lines 246-283): M is correctly gated by pauseMenu/choiceOpen/ending/overlay checks; Esc handling of map is distinct from pause toggle. Verified all 5 map-toggle paths (M, second M, 6-rapid M, close-btn, Esc→pause).

Map.js drawStaticLayer + drawDiscoveredSeal (lines 208-221, 300-357): visited areas use fill alpha 0.72 + stroke alpha 1.00 + 2.0px linewidth + ink-seal dot at cx+30,cy+28; unknown areas use dashed 0.32-alpha strokes with '?' glyph. Visual differentiation is unmistakable in the captured screenshot.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The 3 exploration-polish hotfixes are all working correctly and no regressions were introduced. Zero console errors across a ~90s multi-scenario run including movement stress, map toggle, pause, choice overlay, and puzzle interaction. Note for future runs: (a) window.__wnl.input.keys is the authoritative Set-based key state — poke it directly for movement tests (headless Chromium rAF ~40% wall-clock so give 1.5-3s per action); (b) puzzle pickups run an async kneel-and-interact ceremony (interactables.busy stays true for a few seconds) — poll gameState.seeds for 3-5s after pressing E, or watch the seeds-hud DOM; (c) window.__wnl.interactables.items (not .list) is the correct API for enumerating pickups; (d) window.__wnl.cinematic.stop() reliably skips the opening cinematic.
